column2: ¿Cuántas clases de español tienes a la semana?
column3: cuántas agrees with clases · a la semana = per week (por semana works too)

column1: I have three Spanish classes a week.
column2: Tengo tres clases de español a la semana.
column3: clase de + subject, and the subject stays lowercase
cuál + ser to pick one out of a set · ¿qué asignatura...? also works

column2: Mi asignatura favorita es la historia.
column3: the subject keeps its article after es: la historia

column1: What time do you usually finish?
column3: terminar = to finish (acabar works the same) · normalmente sits after the verb

column1: I usually finish at half past two.
column2: Normalmente termino a las dos y media.
column3: normalmente can also open the sentence · y media = half past

column1: Classes finish at three in the afternoon.
column2: Las clases terminan a las tres de la tarde.
column3: de la tarde with a clock time; por la tarde without one
